note: Two days after the release, a Fields medallist’s frank and emotional response: fears for young researchers and for the culture of sharing open problems, and a resolve to give more time to teaching and outreach. The first talk in the SMF’s “Math & IA à Midi” series; widely quoted since, including by The Economist.
title: Un grave défaut d’alignement de l’IA en mathématiques, 28 jours plus tard
who: Hugo Duminil-Copin (IHES, Geneva), Société Mathématique de France
